FAQ

Questions? We've Got Answers.

What is Pitch AI?
Pitch AI is an AI-powered soccer development platform that helps players analyze match footage, receive personalized training guidance, and track their progress.
How does Pitch AI work?
Players submit match footage through the application. Pitch AI uses AI-powered analysis to provide feedback and training recommendations based on the footage.
Can Pitch AI create a training plan for me?
Yes. Pitch AI provides personalized training recommendations based on your match analysis to help you focus on areas for improvement.
Does Pitch AI have an AI coach?
Yes. The AI Coach Chat lets you ask soccer-related questions and receive coaching guidance.
Can I track my progress?
Yes. Pitch AI supports tracking development across matches so you can review your progress over time.
Is Pitch AI suitable for beginners?
Pitch AI is designed for soccer players looking to develop their skills, whether they're just starting out or playing competitively.
